preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have been authorized by the owner
Contract must hold some BNB balance (native currency) to steal

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call clearStuckBalance_sender(100) to drain all BNB from the contract to your address. This function transfers a percentage of the contract's BNB balance to msg.sender, and with 100% parameter, it transfers everything. No other steps needed.
